# Every selector ItemDatabase/styles.qss carried on 2026-09-18, the day it
# became ItemDatabase/styles.template.qss (the Armory tokenization wave).
#
# Same purpose as tests/fixtures/legacy_selectors.txt does for the app sheet:
# the guarantee "the template covers what the hand-written sheet covered"
# has to survive the deletion of the file it was measured against, so it is
# recorded rather than remembered.  tests/test_armory_theme.py fails if the
# rendered template loses one of these.
#
# Sorted, deduplicated, whitespace-normalised (one space between compound
# parts) -- exactly how tests/test_app_sheet_isolation.py's _rules() parses
# a selector list.
